name: Al-Asasyah
verdict: Al-Asasyah is the mark of Basic Electronics Company Ltd, a limited liability company owned by Mohammed Ahmed Al-Arfaj. Nothing found.
note: Al-Asasyah Electronics (the Saudi agent of the GREE air-conditioner brand, per al-asasyah.com's GREE section) shares the 2026/27 Al-Fateh chest lockup with the GREE brand: the club's partners page lists one partner as 'الأساسية - GREE' linking al-asasyah.com, and the shirt lockup combines the AS/الأساسية oval mark with the GREE wordmark. The GREE brand itself is recorded separately (sponsor 'gree', rated none). Rating note: Basic Electronics Company Ltd is a private Saudi company owned by Mohammed Ahmed Al-Arfaj (al-asasyah-basic-electronics-ownership). No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
